steps.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: coordinated 2D head model sheet for Ava Morgan, Willow Creek game, selected design B.
Input image 1 is the SELECTED B identity and hair design, the edit target. Preserve her adult identity and specific facial structure.
Input image 2 is the actual approved A03 game character: STYLE AND DETAIL LEVEL ONLY. Do not depict, feminize, or redraw him.

Create ONE unified reference sheet, landscape 3:2, six closely coordinated views of exactly the same adult woman. Three equal columns, two equal rows on flat light warm grey. Top row: completely neutral relaxed closed mouth without a smile, front at 0 degrees; anatomical LEFT side in strict clean profile facing image-left at 90 degrees; left-facing three-quarter at about 35 degrees. Bottom row repeats those exact three head angles with only a warm discreet CLOSED-MOUTH smile. Same camera elevation, same scale, zero head pitch or roll, orthographic-like view. All heads and necks, hair top and complete bun visible, cropped below collarbone. Leave clear gutters. No labels, no numbers, no guides, no graphic decorations. Large sharp modeling-reference portraits, not presentation poster.

Identity invariants across ALL six: an elongated adult oval/soft-rectangular face, defined broad cheekbone planes, mature supported jaw with a substantial softly rounded chin; moderate narrow almond brown eyes with restrained iris size and eyelid folds; softly tapered natural low-contrast brows, never solid graphic bars; moderately long straight nose bridge with natural rounded tip and small nostril wings; restrained thin upper lip and moderate lower lip, no lipstick, no protruding pout. Subtle sparse freckles only across nasal bridge and upper cheeks. Preserve B's adult confident identity, do not make her younger or doll-like. Adult balanced proportions. The neutral upper row must have level relaxed mouth corners; the smile changes corners and cheeks gently, not head proportions.

Hair invariants: chestnut brunette, side part ON HER ANATOMICAL LEFT (viewer-right in front; near visible side in our profile/three-quarter). The broad forelock sweeps towards her anatomical right. Same gently angular hairline/temple attachment in every view. Loose LOW bun behind the lower ear at upper nape, continuous gathered scalp volume feeding into the bun, same bun diameter and height across rotations. Keep one thin tapered loose face-framing wisp on either side and a very few short flyaways; no spaghetti, intersections or thick plastic tubes.

Unify all views as one artist-designed head rotation with locked skull depth, cheek/jaw silhouette, eye and brow levels, straight nasal bridge, nasal-base height, mouth-to-chin distance, ear size/attachment and hairline height. In STRICT PROFILE show one eye, one brow, one nostril, no far-eye or far-cheek peek; nose points fully left, not three-quarter. Ear shape and hair part must not change between views. The eyes, brow bases, nasal base, mouth seam and chin align in height across each row. The smile row preserves all skull, ear, hair and neck dimensions from the neutral row.

Simplify the source B to A03's achievable game style: broad clean softly shaded face planes, smooth matte skin with NO pores or microtexture; very few low-contrast freckle marks; hair in about 6 broad flowing primary masses with minimal shallow groove accents, NOT individual photoreal strands, but keep B's asymmetrical sweep, low loose bun and delicate tapered wisps. Soft matte stylized 3D-like painted design rendering, not photographic or glossy. Do not import A03's heavy eyebrows or large eye proportions. Cream crew-neck top, olive apron straps. Soft neutral frontal studio light identical across views, low contrast, no dramatic shadows or perspective. No new identity, no jewelry, no makeup, no teeth, no grins. This is a 2D design reference, not a claim of an existing 3D model.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target image 1 is the coordinated six-view Ava B reference sheet. Image 2 is A03 STYLE ONLY; do not include or redraw him.
Make ONE targeted correction: unify and simplify Ava's HAIR across all six panels, keeping every face, expression, camera, clothing, skin, ear, neck, eye/nose/mouth/jaw position and page layout unchanged.
The upper middle neutral PROFILE is the canonical bun geometry: copy its low loose bun volume, attachment, crown and temple flow to the lower middle smiling PROFILE, with exactly the same height, outline, bottom edge, width and number of bun folds (translated one row down only). The smiling profile currently has a slightly lower/larger bun; remove that inconsistency. Likewise keep the top and bottom 3/4 hair silhouettes exactly identical to each other; the top and bottom FRONT hair exactly identical.
Across ALL views preserve chestnut side part on anatomical left, broad sweep towards her right, thin delicate framing wisps and loose low bun behind lower ear/upper nape. Reduce fine engraved strand marks to a few broad directional grooves and about six primary flowing hair masses, using A03's smooth matte simple surfaces as the detail budget. No photo strand noise, no glossy plastic shine. Preserve the same hair design and grown adult face from the target, not a new hairstyle or identity. Keep the soft low-contrast freckles and natural brows exactly as they are. No changes outside the hair, no labels or guides.

deliverySelection: Three neutral views from top row and three-quarter smile from bottom-right of corrected plate. The redundant smiling front/profile are not delivered modeling references. No pixel-level face repaint/warp; crops and layout only.
reproducibility: Exact prompts recorded. Built-in model/seed are not exposed; generation is not pixel-deterministic. Layout can be repeated from the saved selected PNGs.
